ModMetaData.name: Jawa Ion Weapons (Kolyska)
ModMetaData.author: Kolyska campaign (mandrake)
ModMetaData.description:
Self-contained, industrial-tier Jawa ion armament for the Kolyska run.
A single signature weapon — the Jawa Ion Blaster — plus its own ion damage type and a custom "ion buildup" stun hediff. Design goals: - CAPTURE-NOT-KILL: the weapon disables, it does not draw blood. No lethal damage. - TIERED BY TARGET: relies on the vanilla stun-resistance gradient — mechanoids/droids are overloaded almost instantly; flesh pawns resist and must be worn down by accumulated ion buildup before they collapse (alive) and can be arrested. - NOT VERY DANGEROUS, REWARDS CUNNING + TERRAIN: low damage, slow warmup, long cooldown, modest range, accuracy falloff — you win by ganging up, using cover and chokes, and stacking stuns, not by out-shooting anyone. - SELF-CONTAINED: no dependency on Outer Rim Core, TabulaRasa, or the (end-of-life) Tatooine mod. Pure-XML; no C# assembly required.
The Jawa_IonStun hediff doubles as the "stun -> down" mechanic the capture pipeline (CPERS: Arrest Here) needs.
